description: Source file implementing the XCast functionality within the WPEFramework plugin, including network management, application control, and Thunder plugin communication.

classes.name: XCastImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the XCast plugin functionalities, including network management, application control, event dispatching, and Thunder plugin communication.
